assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:shinei-nouzen@original-light-novels#86-shinei-nouzen-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Shinei Nouzen character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's corpus map and Character Modeling Reference method were read for method, authority order and scope only; the CMR-9 promotion audit, the diagnostic locator index, the relationship matrix, the crosswalk, the ledgers, the specialist documents, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 verdict and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN confidence labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Developmental states from the V01 Spearhead squadron period through the V14 boundary state, with Alter.1 scenes used only in the pre-Federacy and low-pressure placements the profile assigns them; the default is the V14 boundary state in which mature future language and unresolved role-based self-use coexist. States after V14, the resolution of the final arc, a postwar vocation, Undertaker after the war and the course of the V14 sensory loss are expressly not established, and no in-world calendar dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile states a reconstruction thesis (self-reduction into whatever function the situation requires; growth by semantic admission rather than stylistic transformation), seven baseline traits each with a confidence label and a counter-control, a behavioral grammar (attention, observe-narrow-test-act sequence, intervention threshold, premise-oriented decision style, failure and repair style), values restated as conduct, 24 mischaracterization traps and a ten-row counterexample audit with SURVIVES/NARROW/DOWNGRADE dispositions. The claims are located to volume, EPUB route and Phase-5 locator. It is one derived reference artifact whose narrower authorities (L01, Document 02) lie outside this evidence set, and its promotion gates are the project's own; no independent reconstruction test is in the set, so A is not supported.

Section XIV traces V01 (competent carrier with no self-authored future) through V02 civilian capacity, V03 peer-forced return planning, V04 legitimate dependency, V05-V06 abandonment petition, V07 confession, V08 non-exclusive identity, V09 procedural self-monitoring, V10-V11 bounded Undertaker, V12-V13 non-sufficient competence and the V14 coexistence of mature future language with sensory-loss concealment, each tied to located scenes (V01-L008, V03-L022, V04-L032, V06-L036, V07-L054, V08-L031/L032/L034, V09-L004, V10-L059/L060, V12-L028/L029, V13-L085/L089, V14-L044/L055/L059/L061/L147/L197/L199). The semantic-admission sequence orders fourteen attested lines. The profile forbids a completed healed-Shin model and leaves the final arc open. Granularity is volume-level; the ordering of Alter.1 scenes against the mainline is only partly fixed.

Section V records a written-Japanese fingerprint: おれ as first person; plain clipped peer speech with お前 compatible with trust; sustained です/ます toward Lena across procedure, disagreement, extraction requests, abandonment fear, confession and domestic exchanges; 少佐/大佐 giving way to レーナ without eliminating role register; no deference to Frederica; ellipsis as default; politeness that carries refusal (聞けません); and a fourteen-line attested semantic-admission sequence plus located humor lines (それと、誰がお兄ちゃんだ; 遠慮しなくてもいいのに; 試すようなことはやめてくれ; 一人きりじゃ戦えない、弱い死神だから; 助けてくれ). This supports recognition and constraint of register by interlocutor and state. Characteristic sentence endings, hedging and modal inventory and the wider lexical repertoire are routed to L09 and Documents 12 and 16 outside this set, the profile excludes anime performance, and it states that no generated dialogue is evidence, so B is not supported.

Section VIII and the scene bank locate reading while his room is a peer hangout (V01 p-008 ¶20), libraries and museums (V02 p-006 ¶77), open laughter at Kurena slipping (V03 p-009 ¶195), fetching dry clothes for Anju and Dustin (V05), self-inclusion in the enjoyed leave (V07-L006), the paper-airplane deadpan (V08-L031), and Alter.1 cooking failure, forgotten birthday, ruin exploration, the bear for Frederica, hair braiding, the one-wall-away relief and the gift explained as his own wish. Food and palate are temporally indexed against the V14 sensory loss. Much of the domestic texture rests on Alter.1, which the profile labels supplemental and does not generalize beyond its placements, and no mainline domestic routine is described, so B is not supported.

Section VI gives nine directed Shin-to-target registers: Lena in six located phases (institutional V01-L028, trust without possession V04, need inside polite syntax V06-L036, economical confession V07-L054, Alter.1 ordinary intimacy, V11-L054 and V14-L197 care with an interpretive boundary); Raiden as answerable rather than deferential (V03-L022, V04, V13-L085); Frederica sibling-like with protection stopping short of authorship; Theo as trusted directness and care boundary (V14-L061); Kurena as comrade without reciprocal romance (V09 ¶412); Anju as practical unobtrusive care; Fido as wordless routinized relation; Annette as new relation with old history inside it; command as capability-sensitive delegation. Traps 13, 18, 19, 22 and 23 bound each. The registers are Shin-side only, the directed matrix rows and Document 10 are outside the set, and the Anju and Kurena relations rest on few scenes.

Section III.7 separates display threshold from emotional magnitude with located instances (Eugene V02-L034, the V09-L016 helplessness admission, the V14-L197/L199 admission that Rei's violence hurt, Alter.1 bodily relief), and the state-delta table in section VII records what changes and what stays stable in ten states. Interior claims are the profile's inferences from narration and behavior under its focalization control; the narrower trauma and grief authorities (Document 09, T07/T08) are outside the set, and the profile preserves T14-OQ-20 against Lena being sovereign over what he means. Specialist-supported interpretation, not a demonstrated interior model.

Section X locates premise attack (V01-L023 どこに、ですか？; V05-L028 retreat reframing; V14-L147 No Face rejected for eliminating freedom of heart), refusal inside polite morphology (聞けません; the V06 petition), rigidity when competence and self-expenditure align (V03-L022; V14-L055/L059 concealment), correction that lands (V04 delegation, V09-L004 request for peer correction, V13-L085 悪い。助かった, V14-L061 boundary with Theo) and explicit moral disgust. Section XI.5 distinguishes emergency interruption from permanent authority. Conflict evidence is concentrated on Lena, Raiden, Theo and command settings; disagreements with strangers or civilian institutions are thin, and no independent test exists in the set.

Section XIII restates values as conduct with located scenes: particularity in names (V02-L034), pride without exclusivity (V08-L032/L034), agency returned to Frederica and Rito (V11-L025), nonrevenge distinct from forgiveness (V11-L010), freedom as lived volition (V14-L147), political reasoning from his own fallibility (V14-L044). The prediction protocol marks forgiveness and lethal-mission volunteering as questions requiring qualification. The profile routes the normative argument to Documents 05-11 outside this set, the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS or IDEOLOGY, and no deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar moral choice is modeled, so C is not supported.

Sections V.6 and IX record deadpan trap-setting (Alter.1 part0011 ¶25-39), literal puncture (Alter.1 part0023 ¶11-55; V08-L031), rare open laughter (V03 p-009 ¶195; Alter.1 part0029 ¶39-42), embarrassment comedy (Alter.1 part0037 ¶16-38) and his being the target of peers' jokes, with constraints 11, 12 and 28 forbidding constant quips or uniform calm. The repertoire is specific and located, but mainline support is two scenes and the rest is Alter.1 supplemental, so B is not supported.

The profile declares the locked original-Japanese V01-V14 boundary, Alter.1 as audited supplemental, Alter.2 excluded and no V15+ inference, routes locators to the Phase-5 lock and quotation to Phase-8 and the EPUBs, and marks LOCATOR_GAP where a scene lies outside the frozen locator namespace. The 55-scene bank spans every volume and the supplement. The lock and verification artifacts are outside this evidence set, the boundary stops at V14 of a continuing series whose final arc is open, and the profile reads the corpus through the V2 scaffold rather than an exhaustive reread, so B is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations: the drunken-Lena deviation from composure (Alter.1 part0037), V14-L055/L059 concealment of sensory loss after acquiring reasons to live, V04 not rescuing Lena as the better protection, bad cooking and an unrefined palate, misreading Lena's Republic grief (Alter.1 part0052 ¶3-10), and the section XVIII audit that narrows or downgrades reserve, competence, protectiveness and discomfort with dependence. Thirty would-sound-wrong constraints and 24 traps give testable negatives. All of it lives inside one artifact and the audit is the project's own, so A is not supported.

Development is indexed by volume with Phase-5 locators; the profile forbids back-projecting the V14 sensory loss or minimizing it from the earlier bad palate, separates Annette's childhood relation from the present one, places Alter.1 scenes as pre-Federacy or low-pressure, fixes the V14 boundary as the latest state and keeps the T14 open questions open. No in-world dates are given and within-volume order is available only through locators.

conditions: Written-Japanese idiolect only, as the profile defines it; no anime acting, prosody or audiovisual staging is modeled.

The interlocutor is one of the attested relations (Lena, Raiden, Frederica, Theo, Kurena, Anju, Fido, Annette, peer commanders or subordinates) and the line uses that relation's attested register, including polite morphology toward Lena and plain speech toward Raiden.
The developmental boundary is named, and the propositions the line admits do not exceed what the semantic-admission sequence makes sayable at that boundary.

Japanese wording is limited to attested forms; new Japanese is not presented as characteristic, and English rendering keeps the low-excess, ellipsis-tolerant economy and the thirty would-sound-wrong constraints.
Output is non-canonical reconstruction output, never cited as evidence, and abstains where the profile records a lexical or state gap.
scenario_readiness.note: The profile supplies an interlocutor- and state-conditioned written register with attested forms and explicit would-sound-wrong constraints, which is more than fluency; it does not supply a sentence-ending or lexical inventory, excludes anime performance and states that generated dialogue is never evidence. READY would treat the project's own reconstruction gate as validation; NOT_READY would deny the located register model.

conditions: Chronology is fixed to one named V01-V14 developmental state, by default the V14 boundary state in which mature future language and unresolved role-based self-use coexist; no V15+, Alter.2 or anime state is used.
The interlocutor is an attested relation in its attested register, or a stranger only in the adult, officer, child, technician or peer roles the profile says he handles without social panic.

The situation closely matches one of the profile's high-confidence classes: operational crisis, trusted-peer correction, ordinary quiet time, giving care, the Lena private register, Frederica household life, or embarrassing intimacy.

Output is a behavioral tendency with the profile's qualification language (typically, with this interlocutor, under this pressure), abstaining on the open domains: postwar vocation, reversibility of the sensory loss, the ability after the war, Undertaker in peace, a settled disclosure practice, and forgiveness.
No institution, technology, culture or relationship state absent from the V01-V14 corpus is introduced, and no readiness is inherited from the profile's CMR-9 verdict.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V01-V14 state, by default the V14 boundary state after the sensory-loss disclosure, the No Face rejection and the admission that Rei's violence hurt; earlier states only when explicitly selected.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Lena, Raiden, Frederica, Theo, Kurena, Anju, Fido, Annette, or peer commanders and subordinates in their attested registers; strangers only in roles the profile attests.
setting_constraints: Operational crisis, peer correction, ordinary quiet time, caregiving, the Lena private register, the Frederica household or embarrassing intimacy
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V01-V14 corpus
Alter.1-only behaviors stay labeled supplemental and are not generalized
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section XX supplies a bounded prediction protocol with high-confidence classes, predictions requiring qualification and a rule to model from the intersection of state, task, relationship, body and answer-space. Readiness is conditional because the profile itself limits prediction to situations overlapping attested conditions, states that it weakens rapidly outside them, and its reconstruction test is the project's own. READY would license the unconstrained role-play the profile forbids; NOT_READY would deny an explicit protocol built for this use.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: reading, libraries, museums, ruins and records, parallel activity in a shared room, card games, celebrations, gifts fitted to the recipient's taste, household life with Frederica, and low-pressure teasing.
Alter.1-only behaviors (cooking failure, the forgotten birthday, hair braiding, the drunken-Lena scene, the birthday gift) stay labeled supplemental and are not generalized across mainline contexts.
Food, palate and sleep are indexed to the developmental boundary, with the V14 sensory loss neither back-projected nor minimized.
Tactile affection remains relationship- and consent-specific and is not generalized.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary capacity is one of the profile's high-confidence domains, but much of its domestic texture is Alter.1 supplemental and the profile forbids generalizing it. READY would ignore that labeling; NOT_READY would deny repeated mainline ordinary scenes.

The profile records values as conduct and marks forgiveness and lethal-mission volunteering as predictions requiring qualification, but routes the normative argument to specialist documents outside this set and supplies no deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar moral choice; the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS. CONDITIONAL would turn value tendencies into a deliberation model; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located value scenes. This bounds the evidence set, not Shin's moral life.

conditions: Shin-side reconstruction only; Lena's side and the bilateral synthesis belong to Document 10, which is outside this evidence set.

Chronology is fixed to one phase: institutional V01, trust without possession V04, need inside polite syntax V06, economical confession V07, Alter.1 ordinary intimacy, or the V11/V14 care-and-boundary state.
Polite morphology and verbal economy are retained; romantic speech stays direct but not florid, and Lena is neither his sole reason to live nor irrelevant to his future.
Kurena's feelings are not reciprocated, embodied intimacy stays consent- and relation-bound, and no V15+ outcome is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: The Lena relation is the most richly located register in the profile, with six phases and explicit traps. READY would ignore that the profile is Shin-side only and that the ordinary intimacy rests on Alter.1; NOT_READY would deny the located phases.

conditions: Military and operational contexts of the kind narrated for the Eighty-Six and the Federacy: concise capability-sensitive delegation, deliberate affective compartmentalization in command crisis (V11 p-018 ¶35), peer-commander correction (V09-L004), extraction requests when he cannot move (V04-L032), and rejection of orders that make someone disposable.
No tactical doctrine, technology or institutional claim is drawn from the profile; it covers behavior only.
The V14 concealment of sensory loss is retained as a live vulnerability; disclosure is not modeled as reliable when it threatens his role.
No postwar vocation or peacetime professional state is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: Operational command behavior is well located, but the profile confines itself to behavior and routes military-system claims to Document 07 and T05 outside this set. READY would overstate; NOT_READY would deny the located command register.

known_limits.statement: The profile's source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded; no V15+ material is inferred, the final arc is open, and the T14 open questions on postwar vocation, medical honesty, Undertaker after the war, the ability after the war and the limit of Lena's interpretive authority (T14-OQ-16 to T14-OQ-20) are preserved rather than resolved.

V14 shows Shin concealing long-term loss of taste and smell because treatment threatened his role, which the profile reads as proof that role-based self-use remains an active vulnerability after he has acquired reasons to live; the admission that Rei's violence hurt is a major admission, not resolution of the trauma. A healed-Shin model is forbidden.

The voice model is a written-Japanese idiolect and discourse model; anime acting, prosody and staging are excluded, no generated dialogue or hypothetical reconstruction is evidence, and the profile warns that synthetic Japanese must not fill a lexical gap.

Cooking failure, the forgotten birthday, ruin exploration, the bear for Frederica, hair braiding, the drunken-Lena scene, the one-wall-away relief and the birthday gift come from Alter.1, whose supplemental status must remain visible; traits appearing only there are not generalized across mainline contexts.

The profile declares itself derived reconstruction reference promoted by CMR-9, subordinate to the Japanese primary source and the narrower canonical V2 authorities in any conflict; LOCATOR_GAP scenes carry an EPUB route but no Phase-5 locator, and its own QA verdict is a project label rather than independent validation.

Every relationship register is Shin-to-target; bilateral synthesis belongs to Document 10 and the directed matrix. Kurena's romantic investment is unreciprocated in the locked corpus, Annette is a new relation with irreversible history rather than recovered childhood, and Fido is not equipment.

The CMR method, the CMR-9 promotion audit, the diagnostic locator index, the relationship matrix, the crosswalk, ledgers L01/L02/L09, Documents 02, 09, 10, 12 and 16, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the profile's locators and quotations were not rechecked here and no independent or held-out reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only harmony:tuan-kirie@original-novel#comparative-ethics, the active_provisional study COMPARATIVE_ETHICS_AND_FORM.md at basis_commit. The assessment uses its Tuan-specific discussion, especially sections 4 and 7, as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese novel. Other actors' evidence is not transferred to Tuan. Project methods and entrypoints inform provenance and limits only. No separate Harmony monograph, reconstruction model, validation result, primary-witness reinspection, adaptation or cross-work composite is included.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The bounded comparative discussion of Tuan's response to the HAR-U014 treatment/personhood problem and her final confrontation and avowal at HAR-U019. This is not continuous whole-novel coverage, a new temporal-state identity, or an assessment of the subsequent HAR-U020 epilogue; scene knowledge remains local to each moment.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Comparative ethics sections 4 and 7: Tuan finds the brain-as-body/person distinction difficult and later avows her own decision in the confrontation with Miach. These are local tensions and represented commitments. Neither an integrated motivational hierarchy nor a stable general response policy follows from them; the analyst's defense of agency is not automatically Tuan's complete psychology.

The essay locates separate deliberative and final-confrontation moments, but a model of changes in Tuan's knowledge, commitments and dispositions between them has not been established. Mere narrative order does not supply a developmental transition rule.

The essay paraphrases first-person avowal and interprets its formal role. A source-language Tuan register, lexical repertoire, recipient-conditioned speech policy or acoustic voice has not been established from this evidence set.

The curated essay concerns political ethics and a final confrontation; a Tuan-specific account of ordinary routines or mundane responses has not been established. A description of the surrounding health society is not evidence of her every ordinary action.

Tuan's confrontation with Miach and response to Nuaza are identified, but a conditional account of how distinct relationships change her responses has not been established. The personally specific object of the final violence does not itself establish a relationship model.

Section 4 attributes difficulty defending a person/body boundary to Tuan; section 7 interprets her first-person avowal. This supports bounded questions about represented uncertainty and asserted agency. Avowal does not establish freedom from prior influence, all private motives, or the truth of every self-description.

Section 7, linked HAR-U019: Tuan avows a decision and directs final violence toward Miach. The essay distinguishes its personally specific object and bodily immediacy from Clavis's population-scale intervention. This constrains interpretation of that confrontation, not the frequency, escalation or resolution of other conflicts.

Sections 4 and 7 distinguish Tuan's difficulty with the treatment/personhood boundary, her asserted conscious choice, and the absence of moral vindication for revenge. These local deliberative tensions are supported; the comparative essay's broader normative argument is not a demonstrated Tuan decision procedure for unfamiliar ethical choices.
No Tuan-specific humor or play repertoire has been established from the curated comparative essay. This gap does not demonstrate an absence of humor in the character.

The complete active_provisional comparative essay was reviewed as repository analysis. Its Tuan discussion is bounded chiefly to the HAR-U014 treatment/personhood exchange and HAR-U019 final avowal, not a complete character corpus, original-witness rereading, separate monograph, model or HAR-U020 epilogue assessment.

Sections 4 and 7 provide affirmative countercases to flattening Tuan into a fully settled defender of autonomy whose conscious choices are necessarily benign: the treatment/personhood distinction troubles her, and her final asserted choice includes personally directed violence. These are local constraints, not proof that every future choice is violent or that agency is absent.

Section 4 identifies the HAR-U014 exchange and section 7 the HAR-U019 confrontation. They remain distinct disclosed moments, with the assessment ending at the latter. Later epilogue facts, an exact calendar time and a continuous intervening knowledge state are not established by this bounded assessment.

scenario_readiness.note: No generation or evaluation of new Tuan dialogue has been established. English analytical paraphrase of first-person avowal is not demonstrated Japanese dialogue competence.

No counterfactual or materially unfamiliar scenario has been assessed with fixed chronology, interlocutor relationship and setting constraints. No cross-scenario transfer or globally reusable Tuan model is asserted.
No readiness assessment for an ordinary new social encounter has been established from these political and climactic passages; ordinary functioning is not denied.
The essay supports interpretation of bounded canonical ethical tensions. No new ethical-choice scenario, conditional response procedure or independent predictive test has been established.

No romantic or relationship-scenario readiness assessment has been established. The personally specific confrontation with Miach does not determine behavior in another relationship or romantic setting.
No professional-response scenario or occupational behavior model has been established from this curated essay. Project-wide model labels and roles described elsewhere are not inherited.

known_limits.statement: Section 7 distinguishes Tuan's avowal of a conscious act from moral justification of revenge. Her actually violent choice prevents an unqualified inference that asserted agency always entails benign or consent-respecting action.

Section 4 attributes difficulty defending the brain-as-body/person distinction to Tuan. A rigid, fully settled rule rejecting every treatment of psychological suffering would erase that represented difficulty.

Section 7 expressly distinguishes Tuan's personally specific violence from Clavis's nationwide act. Formal first-person parallels cannot transfer his motives, technology, knowledge or scale of action to her.

This assessment establishes no complete weighting of Tuan's private motives, freedom from earlier influence, continuous knowledge trajectory, exact calendar placement or later epilogue state. Missing support is not evidence that a motive or capacity is absent.

Only the subject's directly curated comparative essay qualifies here. Her separate monograph, models, validation trials and original Japanese source have not been independently assessed in this run. Ordinary behavior, source-language voice, relationship transfer, humor and novel-scenario readiness remain unestablished within this evidence boundary, irrespective of broader material elsewhere.

assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mass-effect:commander-shepard@paragon-player-archetype#paragon-shepard-monograph, the canonical interpretive monograph MASS_EFFECT_PARAGON_SHEPARD_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full. It is the study's analytical-corpus formulation of a player archetype extracted from the trilogy's choice space and declares itself not an exhaustive transcript audit. The Renegade monograph and the study's corpus map were consulted for scope and provenance only and are not evidence on this subject. No game transcript, mission dialogue, audiovisual recording, specific playthrough, novel, comic or external documentation is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The whole Mass Effect trilogy as three coarse phases (Mass Effect 1 military diplomat, Mass Effect 2 ethical contaminant inside Cerberus, Mass Effect 3 coalition commander) through the ending choice. No mission-level or in-game chronology, no particular playthrough state, and no pre-trilogy or post-ending state is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph states a governing value hierarchy (duty, proportionality, truth, coalition responsibility, respect for persons, internal constraint), a central belief that the manner of victory determines what survives, and five failure modes. It expressly disclaims that the game wrote one fixed personality and extracts the most coherent military-professional through-line from a player-directed choice space. This supports interpretation of what the archetype values and refuses; it gives no conditional, scene-located behavioral rules.

Three game-level phases are characterized (military diplomat, ethical contaminant within Cerberus, coalition commander), each as a thematic stance. No within-game ordering, mission sequence or state-transition rule is given.

No game dialogue is quoted or analyzed. The monograph's block-quoted lines are the analyst's paraphrases, introduced as what the archetype says in effect, not attested speech. Nothing about Shepard's register is established, which says nothing about the games' actual dialogue.
The monograph contains no ordinary, off-duty or low-stakes behavior; nothing is established.

Relations are given by category: squadmates as persons rather than assets, species and historical enemies as potential co-belligerents, Cerberus and the Illusive Man as ideological temptation, the Council and Alliance as slow institutions. No individual squadmate, romance or crew relationship is named, so only category-level canon questions are supported.

Stated beliefs and fears (fear of becoming what is fought, moral injury under impossible standards, discomfort with every ending) are attributed to the archetype by the analyst. They support bounded questions about the archetype's professed stance; they are not depicted interior states of a specific Shepard.

A force doctrine is stated: protective, proportional, directed, restrained where restraint does not abandon the innocent, with distinctions between coerced and willing enemies, combatants and civilians, factions and species, and an explicit willingness to threaten, deceive and kill when required. Named outcomes (destroying the Collector Base, addressing the genophage, brokering quarian-geth peace) are asserted without scene evidence, so this is a doctrine rather than located conflict behavior.

The monograph's core is an ethical doctrine with a worked deliberation over the four endings, each weighed with reasons, and a Cerberus stance distinguishing use of its resources from adoption of its worldview. It identifies the considerations the archetype weighs and refuses. The deliberation is the analyst's reconstruction of a coherent archetype, unlocated in game text, and its judgment that Paragon most likely chooses Destroy reluctantly is a prediction, not an observation.
Nothing on humor or play is established.

The monograph declares itself a corpus-governing interpretive model and not an exhaustive transcript audit, cites no missions, dialogue lines, codex entries or recordings, and names no edition or playthrough. Trilogy-wide breadth without source location.

Affirmative limits are stated: Paragon is not nice Shepard, not pacifism, legal formalism or every blue dialogue option; five failure modes including naive trust, procedural sentimentalism and game-rewarded idealism; and no ending is fully compatible with the ethic. These counter a flattening benevolent reading, but as interpretive assertions rather than located contradictions.
Only the three-game phase structure and the ending choice are placed in time; no default state is fixed when a period is unspecified, and no mission or date chronology is supplied.

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph contains no attested dialogue and its quotations are analyst paraphrases. Dialogue generated from its principles would be fluent invention, not source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not the games.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The trilogy-wide corpus archetype at any of its three coarse phases; no mission-level moment or playthrough state is fixed.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Any counterpart, since the monograph names no individual relationship; the refusal holds for allies, enemies and institutions alike.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts outside the trilogy's command situations
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than analyst-level value comparison
No fixed personality, located scene evidence or decision procedure is available in this evidence set

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph is designed for comparative analytical use beside other characters and supports value-level comparison by an analyst. It supplies no behavior, speech or decision procedure for simulating Shepard in a crossover or counterfactual and disclaims a fixed personality, so cross-scenario simulation is not supported by this evidence set. The scope below names the only context in which even this refusal was assessed.
No ordinary social content; nothing is established.

conditions: The dilemma is a command-context ethical or political choice of the kind the monograph treats: use of force, coalition trust, truth versus manipulation, civilians, enemy categories, emergency authority.

Output is a value-level account of which considerations the archetype weighs and what it refuses, stated as tendency rather than certainty, with the monograph's failure modes available as counterweights.
No specific game mission mechanics, dialogue lines, squadmate names or playthrough facts are asserted as canon.
The subject is the corpus archetype, not any particular player's Shepard.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph's ending-problem section models this kind of reasoning. Readiness is conditional because the doctrine is interpretive and unlocated in game text.
No romance or intimate-relationship content; nothing is established.

conditions: Military-professional command or political-military context framed by the Alliance, N7 and Spectre foundation the monograph describes.

Prediction is limited to command posture and priorities (discretion used to protect persons and legitimacy, coalition over domination, refusal to let necessity cancel personhood), not to tactics, procedure or speech.
No specific mission, squad composition or in-game outcome is asserted.
The archetype's stated failure modes remain possible outcomes.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph's subject is professional military authority under weakened external constraint, so posture-level professional prediction is supported; operational detail is not.

known_limits.statement: Section 0 and the corpus-use rule state that the game provides a player-directed choice space and that no single psychologically seamless Paragon personality is claimed; every claim here concerns the corpus archetype, not a canonical individual.

The corpus-use rule states that Paragon Shepard is not synonymous with maximum kindness, pacifism, legal formalism or choosing every blue dialogue option, and may threaten, deceive, kill and exercise broad emergency authority.
The front matter and section 0 declare the monograph a corpus-governing interpretive model and not an exhaustive transcript audit; named decisions and outcomes are asserted without scene evidence.

Section 13 records that the trilogy sometimes rewards Paragon choices with unrealistically optimal outcomes, and section 11 that no ending is fully compatible with Paragon ethics; predictions of clean outcomes are unsupported.

dimensions.note: The model states a governing thesis (the strength-and-premium-ingredients equation broken by the V02 defeat without exposing her craft as fraudulent), five gated developmental states with operative policies, stable commitments, and a ten-row conditional decision policy labeled H/M/U with volume-image locators. This is a bounded operational interpretation usable for school-era culinary and club situations. It is one active_provisional secondary artifact whose warrants cannot be rechecked within this evidence set, its validation is the author's own nonblind self-audit, and it marks the childhood memory's broader causal weight as interpretation. No unconstrained simulation support follows.

Five states are gated with transitions and binding limits: recalled family formation (02-168 to 02-169), early Erina-aligned enforcer (02-104 to 02-111), fairly defeated new member (02-166 to 02-175), voluntary collaborator and autonomous cook (V05, V07 and the V08 cutoff), society defender and peer recognition (V20, V21). The endpoint rule forbids presenting the school default as the V36 adult state. The states are coarse, Ikumi-specific states between V08 and V15 and after V21 are not described, and the adult endpoint is expressly unestablished.

Seven attested Japanese forms are recorded from original images with context and limit: あたし; あんた and hostile テメェ; えりな様; mocking 主将さん; surname address 幸平; the hesitant 食べるか？, contracted 食わねぇ and emphatic だからな sequence; and the objection to 肉魅. They support bounded canon questions about address and register in the V02 and V06 scenes. The model states they do not license a complete dialect grammar or an audiovisual performance model, the forms come from two volumes and 22 inspected images, and the discovery row does not enroll SPEECH for this subject.

Observed ordinary texture is limited to the V06 summer bonus (club cooking before Soma arrives, heat complaints, sharp familiar talk with Konishi, a hesitant food offering, conditional acceptance of shaved ice, one strawberry-milk choice; 06-186 to 06-189) plus mainline voluntary community and festival labor (V05, V15, V16). The model labels the bonus low-weight supplementary evidence and extends it only at M to an unfamiliar school kitchen. A domestic routine, nonculinary hobbies, an adult managerial style and the response to a small unrelated loss are expressly unestablished.

A six-row recipient-modifier table (Soma; Konishi and the Donburi Research Society; Erina; community collaborators; independent opponents or judges; unfamiliar juniors, customers or adults) gives per-recipient boundaries, and a matched-recipient rule holds a dish-adjustment request constant across Soma, V21 Erina and an unfamiliar peer. The variation is evidence-based for Soma, Erina and the society; unfamiliar recipients are restricted to task-only inference at M. The evidence is Soma-weighted, the Erina relation rests on two states (V02 patronage and withdrawal, V21 recognition), and the model forbids inferring reciprocity from embarrassment.

Emotion-to-action routing is described for pride, embarrassment, hurt, fair-loss destabilization and affection, each tied to located scenes (V02 anger and honored wager, V06 hurt and qualified acceptance, V21 recognition of Erina's burden). Interior states are inferred from depicted behavior; the model treats Soma-directed romantic coding as an interpretation of bounded evidence and warns against making the childhood memory an automatic flashback. Substantial inference without a demonstrated interior model.

Conflict rules cover escalating formal stakes as early enforcer (02-104 to 02-111), registering a fair defeat while remaining in the field (02-166 to 02-175), accepting contextual correction after the duel (V05), and competing through her own cooking when Central threatens the society (V20, 3-0). A typed failure table and negative controls separate technical, social and institutional consequences and reject expanding the comic knife threat into literal violence. Ordinary conflict outside familiar school work, a later adverse-result response and leadership accountability are declared material gaps.

Established locally: early overreach (demolition planning and demanding Soma's expulsion as a stake) is treated as consequential rather than banter, and V20 reverses the direction of her intervention. The model states this does not prove reflection on earlier harm or an invariably fair leadership style, and marks the junior-complaint probe U. No deliberation procedure for an unfamiliar ethical choice is supplied, and the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model records mockery (主将さん), a comic knife threat and the summer-bonus comic, but treats them as low-weight or as patterns to restrain; no Ikumi humor or play repertoire is established. This gap says nothing about the character's actual humor.

The model draws on the project's completed original-Japanese V01-V36 corpus and verifies 22 images from V02 and V06 against recorded source locks, while stating that no whole-volume, character-arc or full-series primary reread of Ikumi was performed and listing material gaps (later adverse response, full V20 dish and opponent chain, sustained leadership, adult life). Ikumi-specific retrieval is targeted (V02, V05-V08, V15-V16, V20-V21); her V22-V36 appearances are not itemized.

Affirmative canonical limitations are located: the V02 whole-bowl defeat despite real meat skill, the V05 criterion correction, the V07 score of 86 excluded by V08's 91 cutoff, the V06 declined offering, weak V15 stall sales inside a coalition, and the V20 win bounded to local survival. An explicit negative-control list rejects fake-expertise, price-absolutism, romantic-reciprocation, literal-violence and Soma-credit readings. Each case is documented inside one secondary artifact and not independently validated.

The model fixes a default state when time is unspecified, forbids silently backdating endpoint knowledge, locates every rule by volume and archive image, and keeps the serialized ending and the three Le dessert tiers distinct. In-world dates and school years are not fixed and no state after V21 is specified; the rule selects a period, it does not give fine chronology.

dimensions.note: The monograph lists fixed traits (short stature, junior position, untidy apartment, temperament, professional weaknesses, ethical instincts, recurring mistakes) and an arc from believing sincerity and constant presence can compensate for lack of authority to building the conditions through which the girls can stand together; synthesis section 5 names the governing error (self-sacrifice treated as the easiest proof of care) and the corrections (presence as returning and remaining available; honesty over easy reassurance; distributing work in Episode 10). Both are literary characterizations with episode-level placement and no conditional rules, and the synthesis records that his self-sacrifice is acknowledged but not fully resolved, so C is not supported; E would deny a coherent series-long account with a named error and its correction.

An episode-indexed arc: the Episode 1 promise not to disappear, tests through work, separation, failure, Koharu becoming lost and Arisu refusing accompaniment, the Episode 10 shift from carrying the live alone to organizing collective ability, the Episode 11 reassurance correction and invited first-name address, the finale philosophy of capacity transfer, and the OVA reception of Yukimi and Kozue as proof that his care became transmissible. No state gating, default rule or transition conditions exist, so C is not supported; E would ignore the located turning points.

The monograph asserts that he has a fixed voice and recognizable speech rhythm but gives no form, pronoun, address pattern or line; the synthesis quotes no Producer dialogue, and its Japanese quotations belong to the girls and Arisu's mother. Nothing about his register is established; this says nothing about his actual speech.

Established locally: an untidy apartment and nearly empty wallet, spending his own money and losing sleep, the Episode 9 outing (heat safety, rest, play, food, photography) and inclusion in Kaoru's culture of shared meals. These answer bounded canon questions about his private disorder and his conduct on one outing; no ordinary routine, habit or preference pattern is described, so D is not supported.

Arisu receives a three-stage relation (respectful distance under Tachibana-san; tested trust when she rejects his reassurance with 「適当なこと言わないでください」; chosen intimacy when she offers 「ありすでいいです」); Chie receives security without a promise of success, complemented by Tsukasa; Kaoru calls him sensei and notices his tiredness; Haru receives bodily advocacy (he wears her skirt); Koharu and Yukimi receive searching and presence in their own spaces; managers receive poor institutional communication. Variation beyond Arisu is thin, adult-peer relations are barely characterized and no recipient-conditioned rule exists, so C is not supported; E would deny the located Arisu stages and the spread of recipients.

Attributed states: emotionally transparent, excitable, visibly insecure, bad at concealing panic, frightened easily, wanting to tell the girls everything will work out, and an understood final philosophy. These are the analysts' readings of visible conduct with no interior sequence located, so D is not supported; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore explicit attributions.

Located responses: he revises after Arisu rejects his generic reassurance, accommodates Haru's discomfort instead of overriding it, negotiates permission for the rooftop live after the adults reject the proposal, and is described as poor at institutional communication. How he argues, escalates or holds a position is not characterized, so D is not supported.

The synthesis carries much of the series' ethics through his conduct: respecting a boundary before intimacy, learning that reassurance can become dishonesty, making failure survivable without placing institutional consequences on the child, entering the child's world, and the shift from martyrdom to capacity transfer; the monograph credits him with ethical instincts and revised ethics. No scene of deliberation is located, the principles are the analysts' reading of the series' argument, and the finale's concert rescheduling is attributed to the adult production, so C is not supported; E would undervalue the richest dimension of both artifacts.
Neither artifact describes a humor or play repertoire for the Producer; excitability and panic are characterized as insecurity, not comedy. Nothing is established and no inability is inferred.

The synthesis declares complete coverage of Episodes 1-12 and the OVA from the Japanese subtitle and audio tracks, frame archives, scene indices and contact sheets, and the monograph is a post-series reading; Producer claims are placed at episode level across the whole run. Nothing in the set verifies those inputs, no claim is located below episode level, and both artifacts are transcript-derived responses, so C is not supported.

Affirmative limitations: the flaw list (disorganized, financially reckless, poor at institutional communication, frightened easily, presumptuous, reassuring before he knows), Arisu's Episode 11 correction, the initial Episode 10 attempt to carry the project alone, Koharu becoming lost under his supervision with emotional rather than procedural repair, and the synthesis's own limitation that his overwork, spending and disordered private life remain unresolved. These are episode-level and interpretive rather than scene-located countercases, so C is not supported.

Episode numbers give coarse placement for the promise (Episode 1), failure support (Episode 8), the outing (Episode 9), the distributed live (Episode 10), the correction and name change (Episode 11), the debut (Episode 12) and the OVA; no within-episode order, date, pre-series history or default state exists, so D is not supported.

known_limits.statement: The monograph asserts a fixed voice and recognizable speech rhythm without recording any form, and the synthesis quotes no Producer line; its Japanese quotations belong to Miria, Arisu, Yukimi, Kozue and Arisu's mother. Only the paraphrased Episode 1 promise that he is not going anywhere is attributed to him.

The synthesis lists among the series' unresolved tensions that the Producer's overwork, personal spending and disordered private life are acknowledged but not fully resolved; his Episode 10 growth concerns distributing work, and the monograph's claim of a completed developmental arc is bounded by that limitation.

The monograph distinguishes YonaiP, the anime Producer, from U149P across adaptations and from game-avatar and other anime Producers; its 8.5 to 9 out of 10 authorship rating and its comparisons with AkabaneP, TakeuchiP, Shiny Colors and Gakuen Idolmaster are comparative literary judgments of how authored he is, not behavioral evidence, and the manga continuity is not evidence here.

The finale's earlier concert is the adult production's compromise, and the synthesis records that the chairman's intervention solves key problems without a durable child-centered structure; institutional outcomes are not to be credited to the Producer's decisions.

Koharu becomes lost under his supervision and the anime offers apology and reunion rather than prevention; the monograph lists disorganization, financial recklessness, poor institutional communication, fear, presumption and premature reassurance as narratively real flaws. Reliability in supervision and administration must not be assumed.

Both artifacts are transcript-derived post-series responses with episode-level placement only: no scene timestamp, subtitle line or frame reference is in the set, the Japanese audio and subtitle inputs the synthesis names cannot be verified from it, the project's E01-E09 and OVA deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject, and the corpus map records that no standalone Episode 10-12 readings were exported. Yūki Yonai's voice performance is outside the set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
